notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Update v0.5.23 (Improved Meatball Brawl tutorial and more)
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, chefs!
KuloNiku: Bowl Up! Demo v0.5.23 is now live. Be careful, it's hot!

Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved Meatball Brawl tutorial,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animation: customer eating their meal at the restaurant,[/p][/*][*][p]Added new animation: the MC resting in their room at night,[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional customer dialogue variations,[/p][/*][*][p]UI polishing and improvements,[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes and optimization[/p][/*][/list][p]If you'd like to discuss the game with other chefs and share cooking tips, consider joining our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F3u5ApuBr66&snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Discord[/url].
[/p][p]Until your next shift in the kitchen![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Update v0.5.21 (Cozy Mode and Portuguese support)
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, chefs! 
Our Demo v0.5.21 is now live. 

Patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Added Cozy Mode (when activated, timers are turned off for a cozier experience),[/p][/*][*][p]Added Portuguese (Brazilian) localization,[/p][/*][*][p]Added MacOS version (playable but not fully optimized), [/p][/*][*][p]Improved Cutting Board and Food Taste tutorials,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed some dialogues,[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes and optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you'd like to discuss the game with other chefs, you can join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F3u5ApuBr66"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy your next shift in the kitchen![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Update v0.5.20 (French and German language support and more)
notes.notes:
[p]Hi chefs!

Our Demo v0.5.20 is now live.

Patch notes:
- Added French and German language support ([i]please note that all translations in the demo version are provisional and will be improved for the full version[/i])[/p][p] - Reduced black screen transitions[/p][p]- Improved cursor control in the boiling minigame[/p][p]- Minor bug fixes and stability improvements[/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to discuss the game with other chefs, you can join our [url="https://discord.gg/3u5ApuBr66"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll enjoy your next cooking session![/p]
